none: PAS BM-42989D: BM-42989D: Roman silver finger ring with the inscription DMART
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete silver Roman finger ring dating to the second or third century AD and clearly a variation on Guiraud's Type 2h (Guiraud 1989, 181-182). The hoop is hexagonal in plan and rectangular in section. The flat rectangular bezel is decorated with an incised inscription of individual dots reading 'DM/ART' which translates as 'To the God Mars'. Other votive rings inscribed to Mars have been…
